title: HQL 编译：AST -> 逻辑计划 -> 物理计划
expected_output:
HQL 输入:
  SELECT dept, COUNT(*) FROM emp WHERE salary > 5000 GROUP BY dept

[1] 词法分析 tokens:
   ['SELECT', 'dept', ',', 'COUNT', '(', '*', ')', 'FROM', 'emp', 'WHERE', 'salary', '>', 'GROUP', 'BY', 'dept']

[2] 语法分析 AST:
   {'type': 'Select', 'projections': ['dept', 'COUNT(*)'], 'from': 'emp', 'where': {'col': 'salary', 'op': '>', 'val': 5000}, 'group_by': ['dept']}

[3] 逻辑计划 (Logical Plan):
  LogicalProject(dept, COUNT(*))
    LogicalAggregate(group=[dept], agg=[COUNT()])
      LogicalFilter(condition=[salary > 5000])
        LogicalTableScan(table=[[emp]])

[4] 物理计划 (Physical Plan / MR):
  Map 1: TableScan(emp) -> Filter(salary>5000) -> GroupBy(dept) 本地预聚合[combine]
  Shuffle: 按 dept 哈希分区 (hash(dept) % R) 把同 dept 送到同一 Reducer
  Reduce 2: 按 dept 聚合 COUNT(*) -> 写出结果

说明: Hive 用 Antlr 生成 AST, 经 SemanticAnalyzer 转逻辑计划, 再由 Optimizer(CBO/规则) 转物理计划, 最终提交 MR/Tez/Spark 执行。
code:
import re

sql = "SELECT dept, COUNT(*) FROM emp WHERE salary > 5000 GROUP BY dept"
print("HQL 输入:\n ", sql)

# 1) 词法: 简单 token 化
tokens = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z_*]+|[>,=]+|\(|\)", sql)
print("\n[1] 词法分析 tokens:")
print("  ", tokens)

# 2) 语法分析 -> AST (简化为结构化 dict)
ast = {
    "type": "Select",
    "projections": ["dept", "COUNT(*)"],
    "from": "emp",
    "where": {"col": "salary", "op": ">", "val": 5000},
    "group_by": ["dept"],
}
print("\n[2] 语法分析 AST:")
print("  ", ast)

# 3) 逻辑计划
logical = [
    "LogicalProject(dept, COUNT(*))",
    "  LogicalAggregate(group=[dept], agg=[COUNT()])",
    "    LogicalFilter(condition=[salary > 5000])",
    "      LogicalTableScan(table=[[emp]])",
]
print("\n[3] 逻辑计划 (Logical Plan):")
for line in logical:
    print("  " + line)

# 4) 物理计划 (默认 MR 引擎)
physical = [
    "Map 1: TableScan(emp) -> Filter(salary>5000) -> GroupBy(dept) 本地预聚合[combine]",
    "Shuffle: 按 dept 哈希分区 (hash(dept) % R) 把同 dept 送到同一 Reducer",
    "Reduce 2: 按 dept 聚合 COUNT(*) -> 写出结果",
]
print("\n[4] 物理计划 (Physical Plan / MR):")
for line in physical:
    print("  " + line)
print("\n说明: Hive 用 Antlr 生成 AST, 经 SemanticAnalyzer 转逻辑计划, 再由 Optimizer(CBO/规则) 转物理计划, 最终提交 MR/Tez/Spark 执行。")
